verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API v2 documentation covers most core UI functionality — bookings, rescheduling, event types with variable durations and custom fields, schedules, webhooks, round-robin routing, conferencing app connections, and slot lookup — and dedicated docs even target AI agents directly for booking/availability/event-type management. However, there is no evidence of complete parity: documentation doesn't explicitly confirm API coverage for workflows, payments configuration, or app-store integration management that exist in the UI, and community reports flag friction around self-hosting the API itself (comm-3), suggesting some UI capabilities may not be fully API-exposed or freely accessible. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that workflows/payments/app-store UI features are API-manipulable, and independent verification of full API-UI feature parity beyond scheduling core.
